description: Measure, on the merged post-#506 model, two quantities on the expedition hull and nothing else: (1) how often a voyage reaches the VSP reporting threshold, and (2) the reported passenger attack rate among the voyages that do. The composed direct-contact route (#506) replaced whole-body per-epoch emission with a finite donor-hand reservoir, added Liu-derived host-level hand-carriage intermittency, switched activity-resolved contact generation on, and gave the emesis aerosol a source-zone dose, so every posting frequency and conditional attack rate recorded before that merge was measured on a different transmission chain and none of them is carried forward here. Nothing in this manifest is fitted: the dose scale is swept as a declared physical release rate (environmental_faecal_release_log10_g_per_epoch, the legacy dose_adjustment key, -log10 grams of stool released to the environment per epoch) and the readout is reported stratified by it, because the ledger's item 00 records a switch in that exponent near adj 6-7 on the pre-merge chain and forbids reading a posting frequency marginalised across it. The shipped norwalk_gi value (4.0) is one rung of the ladder and carries no privileged status. Voyage length is swept because the observed A9 posting probability is strongly length-dependent (0.33 per 1,000 voyages at 6-7 days against 18.3 at 11-14; midrs_incidence_targets.a9_targets), so a single 168-epoch arm cannot be compared with a fleet-pooled target. Comparators are reported and never optimised against: A4 expedition pre-2020 reported passenger AR over postings (median 5.32 percent, IQR 4.00-10.45, n=21) and the A9 fleet interval (4.19-5.58 per 1,000 voyages) with its length-resolved rows. Containment is a separate axis at the shipped rung so that a change in posting frequency stays attributable to either transmission or quarantine compliance rather than to their product; none_response carries sick_call_probability_per_day 0.0 and is the transmission-only counterfactual, not a posting arm. Sixty voyages per cell (780 runs) is a wall-clock choice, not a power calculation, and it is the campaign's binding limitation: a cell resolves a posting frequency to roughly plus or minus 0.06 near 0.5 and cannot distinguish A9's few-percent target from zero at all, so this campaign can locate the release rung at which posting stops being a near-certainty and can measure the conditional attack rate, and cannot confirm a posting frequency of a few per hundred. Seed blocks are contiguous from 3000 so that an extension re-runs nothing.

c1_exp_posting_curve_7d.description: Posting curve against the declared release scale on a 7-day voyage, one containment level held fixed at mid compliance. Six rungs one log apart bracket the shipped 4.0 on both sides and span the pre-merge switch region (adj 6-7); the ladder locates where posting frequency crosses realistic values on the merged chain rather than asserting a value.

c1_exp_posting_curve_12d.description: The same curve at 288 epochs (12 days), which is the voyage length band whose observed A9 posting probability is 18.3 per 1,000 rather than 0.33. Three rungs, because the 7-day arm carries the resolution of the ladder shape and this arm carries the length contrast.

c1_exp_containment_7d.description: Containment axis at the shipped rung (adj 4.0) on a 7-day voyage: three further compliance levels plus the transmission-only counterfactual. none_response reports no sick calls, so its posting frequency is not a posting measurement and the readout marks it as such; it is here to keep a containment effect separable from a transmission effect.
